## Safety 1

- Show 4 fire pictures
    1. A nice campfire
    2. A campfire surrounded by leaves
    3. A controlled burn
    4. A wildfire started by lightning
- Compare to safety measures. How do you "clear the leaves", "set up baricades", and have "water buckets"


## Coding with Agents (Help with Unit 3)

In Unit 3, the focus is on design, not implementation. Implementation can be done with coding agents, but they need to know how to use them; everyone is at different levels.

The professor probably isn't the best person to teach this. There will always be students more up to date.

On a day, you could propose a discussion, or:
1. Have them record videos to Slack on their tips
2. Instructor/TA organizes and curates to put them in a nice location

## Keeping Slack Sharing Culture

1. Ask them to keep the culture
2. Do an analysis to keep track
    1. Collect several activity metrics
    2. Run a regression to see what is helping students be more active
